title: Successful Customer registration with Aadhaar and PAN
preconditions: The prospective customer is not yet registered and has no in-flight KYC application of the same identity.

steps.action: Perform customer registration with aadhaar and pan with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: A registration record is created and a KYC application (Aadhaar + PAN) is submitted for review.

title: Rejected invalid Customer registration with Aadhaar and PAN
preconditions: The prospective customer is not yet registered and has no in-flight KYC application of the same identity.

steps.action: Attempt customer registration with aadhaar and pan using the condition that produces INVALID_AADHAAR_FORMAT.
steps.expected: The Aadhaar number you entered is not in the expected 12-digit format. Please check the value and try again.

title: Successful Aadhaar and PAN format validation
preconditions: The prospective customer has entered Aadhaar and PAN values during registration.

steps.action: Perform aadhaar and pan format validation with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: Malformed values are rejected and the malformed field is reported; well-formed values are accepted for KYC submission.

title: Rejected invalid Aadhaar and PAN format validation
preconditions: The prospective customer has entered Aadhaar and PAN values during registration.

steps.action: Attempt aadhaar and pan format validation using the condition that produces INVALID_AADHAAR_FORMAT.
steps.expected: The Aadhaar number you entered is not in the expected 12-digit format. Please check the value and try again.

title: Successful Route KYC application to Bank operations review
preconditions: A KYC application has passed format validation and is in a submitted state.

steps.action: Perform route kyc application to bank operations review with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The KYC application is visible to Bank operations in a pending-review state.

title: Rejected invalid Route KYC application to Bank operations review
preconditions: A KYC application has passed format validation and is in a submitted state.

steps.action: Attempt route kyc application to bank operations review with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
steps.expected: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

title: Successful Approve or reject a KYC application
preconditions: The KYC application is in the pending-review state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.

steps.action: Perform approve or reject a kyc application with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The KYC application reaches an approved or rejected state; approval enables account creation in step FR-005.

title: Rejected invalid Approve or reject a KYC application
preconditions: The KYC application is in the pending-review state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.

steps.action: Attempt approve or reject a kyc application using the condition that produces KYC_NOT_APPROVED.
steps.expected: Your identity (KYC) has not been approved yet, so this action is not available. Please wait for your KYC review to be completed.

title: Successful Create pending account on KYC approval
preconditions: A KYC application associated with the customer has been approved.

steps.action: Perform create pending account on kyc approval with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: An account record is created in the pending state, not yet usable for transactions.

title: Rejected invalid Create pending account on KYC approval
preconditions: A KYC application associated with the customer has been approved.

steps.action: Attempt create pending account on kyc approval with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
steps.expected: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

title: Successful Activate a pending account
preconditions: The account is in the pending state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.

steps.action: Perform activate a pending account with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The account transitions to the active state and becomes usable for transactions.

title: Rejected invalid Activate a pending account
preconditions: The account is in the pending state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.

steps.action: Attempt activate a pending account using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
steps.expected: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

title: Successful Freeze an active account
preconditions: The account is in the active state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.

steps.action: Perform freeze an active account with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The account transitions to the frozen state; it no longer permits outgoing transfers.

title: Rejected invalid Freeze an active account
preconditions: The account is in the active state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.

steps.action: Attempt freeze an active account using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
steps.expected: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

title: Successful Login with valid credentials
preconditions: The user holds a valid identity and credentials for the Customer or Bank operations role.

steps.action: Perform login with valid credentials with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: An authenticated session is established for the user.

title: Rejected invalid Login with valid credentials
preconditions: The user holds a valid identity and credentials for the Customer or Bank operations role.

steps.action: Attempt login with valid credentials using the condition that produces AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.
steps.expected: Your username or password is incorrect. Please check your credentials and try again.

title: Successful Reject login with invalid credentials
preconditions: A user submits a login attempt with invalid credentials.

steps.action: Perform reject login with invalid credentials with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The login attempt is rejected and no session is established.

title: Rejected invalid Reject login with invalid credentials
preconditions: A user submits a login attempt with invalid credentials.

steps.action: Attempt reject login with invalid credentials using the condition that produces AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.
steps.expected: Your username or password is incorrect. Please check your credentials and try again.

title: Successful Logout and terminate session
preconditions: The user holds an authenticated session.

steps.action: Perform logout and terminate session with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The session is terminated and protected functionality is no longer accessible.

title: Rejected invalid Logout and terminate session
preconditions: The user holds an authenticated session.

steps.action: Attempt logout and terminate session using the condition that produces SESSION_EXPIRED.
steps.expected: Your session has ended, either because you logged out or because it expired. Please log in again to continue.

title: Successful Customer initiates a transfer
preconditions: The Customer is authenticated, holds an active account, and specifies a transfer amount and a recipient account.

steps.action: Perform customer initiates a transfer with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: A transfer is processed that debits the sender balance and credits the recipient balance, and a transaction is recorded.

title: Rejected invalid Customer initiates a transfer
preconditions: The Customer is authenticated, holds an active account, and specifies a transfer amount and a recipient account.

steps.action: Attempt customer initiates a transfer using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
steps.expected: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

title: Successful Prevent Bank operations from initiating transfers
preconditions: A Bank operations user attempts to initiate a money transfer.

steps.action: Perform prevent bank operations from initiating transfers with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The attempt is denied and no transfer is created.

title: Rejected invalid Prevent Bank operations from initiating transfers
preconditions: A Bank operations user attempts to initiate a money transfer.

steps.action: Attempt prevent bank operations from initiating transfers using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
steps.expected: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

title: Successful Debit sender and credit recipient on success
preconditions: A transfer initiated by a Customer passes all validation checks.

steps.action: Perform debit sender and credit recipient on success with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The sender's balance is reduced by the transfer amount and the recipient's balance is increased by the same amount.

title: Rejected invalid Debit sender and credit recipient on success
preconditions: A transfer initiated by a Customer passes all validation checks.

steps.action: Attempt debit sender and credit recipient on success using the condition that produces INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.
steps.expected: The transfer amount exceeds the available balance on your account. Please enter a smaller amount and try again.

title: Successful Record a transaction for every transfer
preconditions: A transfer has been successfully processed.

steps.action: Perform record a transaction for every transfer with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: A transaction entry exists and is visible to both the sending and receiving Customer.

title: Rejected invalid Record a transaction for every transfer
preconditions: A transfer has been successfully processed.

steps.action: Attempt record a transaction for every transfer with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
steps.expected: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

title: Successful View an account statement
preconditions: The user is authenticated and selects an account and a period they are permitted to view.

steps.action: Perform view an account statement with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: A statement for the selected account and period is displayed.

title: Rejected invalid View an account statement
preconditions: The user is authenticated and selects an account and a period they are permitted to view.

steps.action: Attempt view an account statement using the condition that produces ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND.
steps.expected: The account you are looking for could not be found. Please check the account details and try again.

title: Successful Download an account statement as a file
preconditions: The Customer is authenticated and selects their own account and a statement period.

steps.action: Perform download an account statement as a file with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: A downloadable statement file is produced for the Customer.

title: Rejected invalid Download an account statement as a file
preconditions: The Customer is authenticated and selects their own account and a statement period.

steps.action: Attempt download an account statement as a file using the condition that produces INVALID_STATEMENT_PERIOD.
steps.expected: The statement period you selected is not valid. Please choose a period with a start date before the end date.

title: Successful Audit-trail view of account and transaction state changes
preconditions: The actor holds the Bank operations role and is authenticated.

steps.action: Perform audit-trail view of account and transaction state changes with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: Bank operations can view the recorded state changes for accounts and transactions.

title: Rejected invalid Audit-trail view of account and transaction state changes
preconditions: The actor holds the Bank operations role and is authenticated.

steps.action: Attempt audit-trail view of account and transaction state changes using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
steps.expected: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

title: Successful Baseline security controls
preconditions: KYC or account data exists in the system.

steps.action: Perform baseline security controls with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The data remains protected through encryption in transit and role-based access control.

title: Rejected invalid Baseline security controls
preconditions: KYC or account data exists in the system.

steps.action: Attempt baseline security controls using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
steps.expected: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

title: Successful Mask Customer PII outside KYC review
preconditions: Aadhaar or PAN data is rendered in a UI display or written to a log.

steps.action: Perform mask customer pii outside kyc review with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: PII is masked everywhere except authorized KYC review contexts.

title: Rejected invalid Mask Customer PII outside KYC review
preconditions: Aadhaar or PAN data is rendered in a UI display or written to a log.

steps.action: Attempt mask customer pii outside kyc review with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
steps.expected: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

title: Successful Baseline accessibility conformance
preconditions: A customer-facing screen is rendered.

steps.action: Perform baseline accessibility conformance with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The screen is keyboard-navigable and its form fields are labeled.

title: Rejected invalid Baseline accessibility conformance
preconditions: A customer-facing screen is rendered.

steps.action: Attempt baseline accessibility conformance with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
steps.expected: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

title: Successful Log every state-changing action
preconditions: A state-changing action on a KYC application, account, or transaction is performed.

steps.action: Perform log every state-changing action with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The action is logged with actor, timestamp, and before/after state.

title: Rejected invalid Log every state-changing action
preconditions: A state-changing action on a KYC application, account, or transaction is performed.

steps.action: Attempt log every state-changing action with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
steps.expected: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

title: Successful Schema-valid, source-linked artifacts
preconditions: An agent-generated artifact is produced at any pipeline stage.

steps.action: Perform schema-valid, source-linked artifacts with valid data and permissions.
steps.expected: The artifact is schema-valid and carries explicit source links.

title: Rejected invalid Schema-valid, source-linked artifacts
preconditions: An agent-generated artifact is produced at any pipeline stage.

steps.action: Attempt schema-valid, source-linked artifacts with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
steps.expected: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

title: Successful Reliable and testable end-to-end journeys
preconditions: An in-scope customer journey is available in the system.
